title: Resend 寄件服務 Repo 與帳戶預備
content:
為後續 AF-016 Resend 程式整合準備寄件網域、憑證與 repository 設定；本卡不切換現有 SES 發信，也不修改目前郵件程式碼。

任務：
1. Resend 帳戶與網域
   - 使用 Resend 驗證專用寄件網域或子網域，依 Resend 提供的 DNS 記錄設定並確認 SPF、DKIM、DMARC 狀態
   - 保留既有收信 MX 與其他郵件供應商設定；若 SPF 已存在，合併寄件來源到單一 SPF 記錄，不新增重複記錄
   - 建立專用 server-side API key；不得提交、貼入文件或記錄實際 key
   - 確認 Resend 的資料處理／儲存區域符合收據與註冊資料的使用要求，記錄決策

2. Repository 設定準備
   - 在 .env.example 加入空白範例與說明：APP_RESEND_API_KEY、APP_RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET、APP_EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS、APP_EMAIL_FROM_NAME、APP_EMAIL_REPLY_TO
   - 釐清管理員審計 BCC 的實際收件地址；若與寄件地址不同，加入可選 APP_EMAIL_AUDIT_BCC 設定，明確區分 From 與 BCC
   - 建立 doc/resend-setup.md，記錄 SMTP host smtp.resend.com、username resend、TLS port 選項，以及本機／Amplify 透過 server-only 環境變數設定 secrets 的步驟
   - 在本機 .env 與 Amplify 設定 Resend API key、寄件地址等值；APP_RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET 於 AF-016 建立 webhook 後再填入
   - 此階段保留現有 SES 程式碼、APP_SES_* 設定與 AWS S3 設定；不要修改或提交 .env 機密檔案

⚠️ AF-016 依賴本卡完成；本卡結束時仍由既有 SES sender 負責現有應用郵件。
refs: Resend dashboard domain and API key settings
acceptance: Resend sending domain is verified; SPF/DKIM checks pass and DMARC policy remains valid
Existing MX and other provider records are preserved; SPF has no duplicate TXT policy
A dedicated Resend API key is configured only in local/Amplify server-side secrets and is absent from tracked files and logs
.env.example documents the Resend environment variable names with empty, non-secret placeholders
SMTP setup instructions and local/Amplify secret setup steps are recorded in doc/resend-setup.md
The intended audit BCC destination is documented separately when it differs from the From address; APP_EMAIL_AUDIT_BCC is added as an optional placeholder only when confirmed
Resend data-processing location has a recorded suitability decision for receipt data
Existing SES code/configuration and AWS S3 settings remain unchanged
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: .env.example (add Resend variables only; retain APP_SES_* for now)
doc/resend-setup.md (new — Resend SMTP and secret setup guide)
Amplify environment variables (manual; server-side secrets only)
verification: Verify Resend domain status and DNS records in Resend; confirm documented env names match local/Amplify server-side settings without exposing secret values; run npm run typecheck && npm run lint. Confirm current SES sender and S3 configuration remain untouched.
